web-1997.explanation: Netflix was founded in 1997 — a decade before it started streaming online.

web-1998.explanation: Google was founded in 1998 — after Netflix, but years before Facebook and YouTube.

web-2001.explanation: Wikipedia launched in 2001 — the same year Apple introduced the iPod.

web-2004.explanation: Facebook launched in 2004 — the same year Gmail and Firefox 1.0 arrived.

web-2005.explanation: YouTube’s first video appeared in 2005 — before Twitter and the first iPhone.

web-2006.explanation: Twitter launched in 2006 — one year before the first iPhone and Netflix streaming.

web-2007.explanation: The first iPhone was unveiled in 2007 — the same year Netflix began streaming and Amazon released Kindle.

web-2009.explanation: WhatsApp launched in 2009 — before Instagram, Snapchat and Tinder.

web-2010.explanation: Instagram launched in 2010 — after WhatsApp, but before Snapchat and Twitch.

web-2011.explanation: Snapchat launched in 2011 — the same year Twitch and Siri arrived.

web-2012.explanation: Gangnam Style hit one billion YouTube views in 2012 — the same year Tinder launched.

web-2013.explanation: Vine launched in 2013 — the same year Slack launched and Doge broke out.

web-2014.explanation: The Ice Bucket Challenge dominated feeds in 2014 — a year before Discord and The Dress.

web-2015.explanation: Discord launched in 2015 — four years after Twitch and two years after Slack.

web-2016.explanation: Pokémon GO exploded in 2016 — a year before Fortnite Battle Royale.

web-2017.explanation: Fortnite Battle Royale launched in 2017 — the same year Distracted Boyfriend became a meme.

web-2018.explanation: TikTok’s global rise accelerated in 2018 after the Musical.ly merger — two years before its pandemic-era boom.

web-2019.explanation: Disney+ launched in 2019 — the same year Baby Yoda memes took off.

web-2020.explanation: GPT-3 arrived in 2020 — two years before ChatGPT made generative AI mainstream.

web-2021.explanation: Wordle appeared in 2021 — a year before ChatGPT and BeReal’s breakout year.

web-2022.explanation: ChatGPT launched in 2022 — the same year Musk completed the Twitter acquisition.

web-2023.explanation: Threads launched in 2023 — the same year Twitter was rebranded as X and GPT-4 arrived.

extra-1995-ebay.explanation: eBay began as AuctionWeb in 1995 — years before online shopping felt routine.

extra-2001-ipod.explanation: The iPod arrived in 2001 — six years before the first iPhone.

extra-2003-steam.explanation: Steam dates to 2003, before YouTube, Reddit and the iPhone.

extra-2004-gmail.explanation: Gmail launched in 2004, before YouTube and two years before Twitter.

extra-2004-firefox.explanation: Firefox 1.0 arrived in 2004 — four years before Chrome entered the browser race.

extra-2005-reddit.explanation: Reddit launched in 2005 — before Twitter, the first iPhone and Instagram.

extra-2005-google-maps.explanation: Google Maps launched in 2005, before the smartphone era made maps feel inseparable from phones.

extra-2007-kindle.explanation: The first Kindle and the first iPhone both arrived in 2007.

extra-2007-tumblr.explanation: Tumblr launched in 2007 — before Instagram, Pinterest and Snapchat.

extra-2008-chrome.explanation: Chrome launched in 2008, the same year Apple opened the iPhone App Store.

extra-2008-app-store.explanation: The App Store opened in 2008 — a year after the first iPhone itself launched.

extra-2009-minecraft.explanation: Minecraft’s first public version appeared in 2009 — before Instagram, Twitch and Snapchat.

extra-2010-ipad.explanation: The first iPad arrived in 2010, the same year Instagram launched.

extra-2010-pinterest.explanation: Pinterest dates to 2010 — before Twitch, Snapchat and Tinder.

extra-2011-twitch.explanation: Twitch launched in 2011 — four years before Discord.

extra-2011-siri.explanation: Siri reached the iPhone in 2011 — more than a decade before ChatGPT.

extra-2013-slack.explanation: Slack launched in 2013 — two years before Discord and almost a decade before ChatGPT.

extra-2014-twitch-amazon.explanation: Amazon bought Twitch in 2014 — only three years after Twitch launched.

extra-2015-openai-founded.explanation: OpenAI was founded in 2015 — seven years before ChatGPT turned it into a household name.

extra-2020-zoom.explanation: Zoom became a defining 2020 habit, even though the company and product had existed for years before the pandemic.

extra-2021-meta.explanation: Facebook became Meta in 2021 — one year before ChatGPT launched.

extra-2022-twitter-musk.explanation: Elon Musk completed the Twitter acquisition in 2022 — the same year ChatGPT launched.

fun-1997-aim.explanation: AIM launched in 1997 — before Google was incorporated and years before MSN Messenger.

fun-2001-itunes.explanation: iTunes launched in 2001, before the iTunes Store and six years before the iPhone.

fun-2002-xbox-live.explanation: Xbox Live launched in 2002 — before Steam, YouTube and modern social media.

fun-2003-linkedin.explanation: LinkedIn launched in 2003 — before Facebook, YouTube and Twitter.

fun-2006-wii.explanation: The Wii arrived in 2006 — a year before the first iPhone.

fun-2007-netflix-streaming.explanation: Netflix began streaming in 2007 — the same year the first iPhone went on sale.

fun-2008-spotify-launch.explanation: Spotify launched in 2008 — after Netflix streaming, but before Instagram and Twitch.

fun-2012-tinder.explanation: Tinder launched in 2012 — before Vine, Slack and Discord.

fun-2013-doge.explanation: Doge broke out in 2013 — the same year Slack launched and two years before Discord.

fun-2015-the-dress.explanation: The Dress debate happened in 2015 — the same year Apple Watch launched and OpenAI was founded.

fun-2020-among-us.explanation: Among Us became a breakout hit in 2020 even though the game had originally released earlier.

fun-2021-gamestop.explanation: The GameStop trading frenzy happened in 2021 — the same year Facebook rebranded as Meta.

fun-2022-bereal.explanation: BeReal’s breakout year was 2022 — the same year Musk bought Twitter and ChatGPT launched.

fun-2023-twitter-x.explanation: Twitter became X in 2023 — the same year GPT-4 launched.
